_comment: What an /event/<id> response must carry before any script runs. This file is written before the Worker code that satisfies it; tools/event-head.mjs reads it and never the other way round. Rule since 2026-11-19 (second version): a search engine or link-preview bot waits up to 1.5 s for the event's metadata and gets the name in the head and a real 404 for an id the archive lacks; anyone else waits at most 75 ms, then gets the plain shell with status 200, and the read finishes in the background. `as` picks a user agent from `agents` (or `agent` gives one literally). `data` picks how the stand-in data host behaves, from `data_modes`. `status`, `title`, `description`, `og_title`, `canonical` are compared exactly against the parsed HTML (entities decoded); "generic" means the value in `generic`. `min_ms` / `max_ms` bound the response time against the local Worker. Description rule: name, year and place only, from the archive's own fields; nothing organizer-written.
